title: Icaha co ku nkengera y'ikiyaga
intro: Uhagaze ku musenyi w’inkengera y’ikiyaga yibagiwe, aho imiraba ivugana n’umuryango w’abantu bageragejwe n’itegeko ry’Imana. Imbeho iraremereye n’ukwibuka ukurenga ku mategeko kwatumye haba ihinduka ritangaje. None abo bantu bari bande, kandi ikigeragezo cabo cari kimeze gute?
clues: Twari umuryango waronse itegeko ritomoye rivuye ku Mukama wacu, yamara twaronse uburyo bwo kurirwanya.
Twaba hafi y'ikiyaga, kandi ubuzima bwacu bwavana n'ibiremwa vyo muri co.
Ikigeragezo caraje kuri twebwe ku musi twategetswe kwirinda gukurikirana ivy’isi.
Ivyo bikoko vyo mu mazi vyaje kuri twebwe ari vyinshi cane uwo musi nyene, bitugerageza birenze urugero.
Twarahinguye ubuhendanyi bwo gukingira urutonde rw’Imana, twiyumvira ko twoshobora gusumba itegeko.
Ukucumura kwacu kwatumye duhinduka biteye isoni; twacitse inkende zisuzugurwa n’itegeko rya Allah.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
